display.summary: Fourth 1.16 beta. Pages no longer send the system configuration to visitors, detail views and the section manager escape stored values, and XLSX exports write text instead of formulas. Citizen-facing pages get a thin public shell that runs under a strict content security policy, and public forms get per-address and total rate limits. A 1.16.0b1, b2 or b3 deployment updates inline; from 1.15.x, follow the 1.16.0b1 upgrade path.
highlights: Security: pages no longer embed the system configuration; scripts get only theme, fonts, password rules and the inactivity timeout.
Security: the detail view and the section manager's modals escape stored values, so a stored tag cannot run script for staff.
Security: XLSX exports write values that start with = as text, never as formulas.
Security: public forms are rate-limited per address and in total; a refused post gets 429 with Retry-After.
Public pages: dlux/public_base.html, a thin shell under script-src 'self' and style-src 'self', and a /fonts/<slug>.css route.
From 1.16.0b1, b2 or b3 this beta installs inline. From 1.15.x: image on 1.16, ./start.sh check --fix with Composer 1.10+, recreate.
